name: TOD-ProcBench
description: TOD-ProcBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' abilities to understand and follow complex, multi-level process instructions in multi-turn task-oriented dialogues. It features three tasks assessing retrieval of relevant instruction statements, detection of instruction-violating responses, and conditional generation of instruction-following responses.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the paper introducing TOD-ProcBench, so it is not yet widely adopted but is relevant for emerging work on process-following in task-oriented dialogue.
notes: Focuses on complex process instructions with fine-grained constraints in multi-turn dialogues; includes multilingual and instruction format studies.
